note: Every dynamic import, and what reads its module in before a person can reach it (scripts/rules-lint.mjs). Nothing is imported on a user tap.

imports.src/ui/host.js → ../worker-core.js: only when a Worker cannot start (the engine runs on the page instead), at boot
imports.src/ui/presenter.js → ../worker-core.js: the same fallback for a presentation's own engine, when its Worker cannot start
imports.src/ui/main.js → ./presenter-view-page.j: only the presenter's second window (?presenter-view), whose page loads it at boot instead of the app; no person reaches it from a tap
imports.src/ui/main.js → ./doppler.js: main.js warmUp, idle after boot and under the loading cover
imports.src/ui/main.js → ./fibroscan.js: main.js warmUp, idle after boot and under the loading cover
imports.src/ui/main.js → ./presenter.js: main.js warmUp, idle after boot and under the loading cover
imports.src/ui/main.js → ./palette.js: main.js warmUp, idle after boot and under the loading cover
imports.src/ui/presenter.js → ./test-decks/demo-: the preview copy only, when the presenter module is read in
imports.src/ui/stage.js → ./lobule-zoom.js: stage.js lobuleCode, once the figure is shown (prepIdle), long before the lobule can be opened
imports.src/ui/stage.js → ./organ-art-lite.js: at boot only, when storage still holds Lighter organ art on (pps.fig.lightArt); its Settings row is gone, so no tap reaches it
imports.src/ui/text-gl.js → ./glyph-data.js: gl-words.js and label-gl.js call loadGlyphs at boot
imports.src/ui/text-gl.js → ./glyph-data-opsz.js: loadGlyphs fetches it with glyph-data.js (gl-words.js and label-gl.js call loadGlyphs at boot)
imports.src/ui/text-gl.js → ./glyph-metrics.js: NOT YET: loadMetrics fetches it where a paragraph is laid out, and no app code calls loadMetrics yet (only the tests); whoever wires layoutParagraph in must call it at boot or idle, never on a tap
